text: Namaste, maine ek kurta mangwaya tha jiska return schedule kiya tha chaar din pehle. Confirmation SMS bhi aa gaya tha mere paas, lekin abhi tak koi lene nahi aaya hai. Return window band hone wali hai aur main bahut pareshan hoon ki mera return expire na ho jaye. Pata karo na status kya hai mera.
